set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4

cd /root/structfuse

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints"
RESULTS_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/eval_results"
MODEL="/root/structfuse/models/Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"
mkdir -p $RESULTS_DIR

for SEED in 42 123 456; do
  for STRATEGY in random embedding dataflow; do
    RUN_NAME="p2b_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
    CKPT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/p2b_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}/final"

    if [ ! -f "$CKPT_DIR/model.pt" ]; then
      # Try parent dir
      CKPT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/p2b_${STRATEGY}_s${SEED}"
      if [ ! -f "$CKPT_DIR/model.pt" ]; then
        echo "SKIP $RUN_NAME: no model.pt found"
        continue
      fi
    fi

    LOG="${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_eval.log"
    if [ -f "$LOG" ] && grep -q "recall@1" "$LOG"; then
      echo "SKIP $RUN_NAME: already evaluated"
      continue
    fi

    echo "=== Evaluating $RUN_NAME (ckpt: $CKPT_DIR) ==="
    python scripts/eval_p2b.py \
      --ckpt-dir "$CKPT_DIR" \
      --model-name "$MODEL" \
      --device cuda:0 \
      2>&1 | tee "$LOG"

    # Extract JSON metrics from output
    python3 -c "
import re, json
with open('$LOG') as f:
    text = f.read()
m = re.search(r'Results:\s*(\{.*\})', text, re.DOTALL)
if m:
    metrics = json.loads(m.group(1))
    metrics['run'] = '$RUN_NAME'
    with open('${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_eval.json', 'w') as out:
        json.dump(metrics, out, indent=2)
    print(f'Saved: ${RESULTS_DIR}/${RUN_NAME}_eval.json')
else:
    print('WARNING: could not parse metrics from log')
"
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== All evaluations complete ==="
echo ""

# Aggregate results
python3 -c "
import json, glob, os
results = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob('${RESULTS_DIR}/*_eval.json')):
    name = os.path.basename(f).replace('_eval.json', '')
    with open(f) as fp:
        data = json.load(fp)
    data['run'] = name
    results.append(data)

if not results:
    print('No results found.')
else:
    print('| Run | Recall@1 | Recall@5 | Recall@10 | Total |')

"
